sermon.title: The Presence of the Lord — June 28, 2020
sermon.speaker: Blake Fambrough
sermon.summary: Blake Fambrough preaches on the weight Jesus carried for every sin and His disfigurement on the cross. Jesus’ words are spirit and life. God’s presence convicts without condemning, as the woman who touched His hem found. The letter kills but the Spirit gives life, and the message closes with a pledge of allegiance to Jesus.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: Is help coming?
faqs.answer: He prays that help is coming even when all hope seems lost.

faqs.question: What weight was on Jesus?
faqs.answer: He took on every sin for every person for all time and became sin at that moment.

faqs.question: Will this church die?
faqs.answer: Never, if we keep speaking and living by God’s word and give attention to His presence.

faqs.question: What are we armed with?
faqs.answer: Not guns or swords of steel but the sword of the Spirit, as His warriors and army.
